It also states that his aim was to prevent a pandemic from zoonotic diseases.

The Planner didn't verify the exact disease name against the sources properly.

So, the mistake was made by the Planner at step 5, where they updated the understanding and declared the task complete with the wrong disease name. The reason is that they didn't correctly interpret the information from WebSurfer, leading to an incorrect generalization.
